text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet is standing alone on the training track...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just what is going on here?
My body won't move the way I want it to...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can become number one like this...
If things stay this way...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I just feel so pathetic, I can't stand it...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I know. I know I have to do something.
And yet, this is...

She's clearly not herself, which is worrying.
It looks like we'll need to reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
